verdict.rationale: WorkOS Directory Sync explicitly supports SCIM across dozens of IdPs, delivers automatic webhook/event updates for user/group/directory changes (which includes deprovisioning), and RBAC docs confirm IdP role assignment via SSO and Directory Sync integrates with session enforcement — directly enabling revocation of app access when an IdP deprovisions a user. Community testimonials corroborate real-world use of WorkOS's SCIM wizard reducing integration pain. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of deprovisioning latency/behavior in production, not just vendor docs.
